segments.speaker: Dhaval Patel
segments.text: Let's start. Today we need to review the field visit backlog in the West region and decide on the new expense limit.

segments.speaker: Priya Shah
segments.text: West region has 42 pending visits, mostly High Touch customers not seen in two weeks. I think we should prioritize those before month end.

segments.speaker: Dhaval Patel
segments.text: Agreed. Priya, can you send the prioritized visit list to the West team by Friday?

segments.speaker: Priya Shah
segments.text: Yes, I'll send it by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rakesh Mehta
segments.text: On the expense limit, I looked at last month's data -- three employees went over the travel limit. I suggest we raise the travel limit from 2000 to 2500 rupees per trip.

segments.speaker: Dhaval Patel
segments.text: Let's go with that. Rakesh, please update the expense policy document and circulate it to all managers.

segments.speaker: Rakesh Mehta
segments.text: Will do, I'll have it out by next Wednesday.

segments.speaker: Priya Shah
segments.text: One more thing -- we still haven't decided who owns the customer re-categorization project. That's still open.

segments.speaker: Dhaval Patel
segments.text: Good point, let's leave that as an open question for next week's meeting.
